title: **Identification of genes directly regulated by a transcription factor in rice**
protocol: Construct a tandem affinity protein (TAP) tagged HYR construct in pUC19.
Assemble the CaMV35S promoter at XbaI and BamHI sites.
Clone the gateway cassette between BamHI/KpnI sites for cloning gene of interest.
Amplify coding sequence for six His repeat, 9x-myc peptide, a 3C protease cleavage site, and two copies of the IgG binding domain using pCTAPa as template at KpnI/SacI sites.
Clone the NOS terminator at KpnI/EcoRI sites.
Cloned the entire cassette between Xba1-EcoR1 sites of pMOG22.
Use FIRE for de novo discovery of short DNA motifs specific to genes differentially regulated upon HYR expression.
Compare motif content of 1 Kb upstream sequences of these genes with that of the rest of the genome.
Compare identified motifs to known cis-elements.
Prepare crosslinking buffer by mixing 3.4g of sucrose, 1 ml sodium phosphate buffer (10 mM, pH7), and 1 ml NaCl (50 mM). Adjust the volume to 100 ml.
Autoclave and store the crosslinking buffer on ice before use.
Prepare Buffer A by mixing 250 µl sodium phosphate buffer (10 mM, pH7), 500 µl NaCl (100 mM), 3.2 ml of 2-methyl-2,4-pentanediol, and 17.7 µl of β-mercaptoethanol.
Adjust the volume to 25 ml for Buffer A.
Add half a tablet of protease inhibitor cocktail to Buffer A.
Store Buffer A at 4°C for further use.
Mix 250 µl sodium phosphate buffer (10 mM, pH7), 500 µl NaCl (100 mM), 250 µl MgCl-2 (10 mM), 625 µl Triton-X-100 (0.5%), and 3.2 ml of 2-methyl 2.4 pentanediol.
Add 17.7 µl of β-mercaptoethanol to the mixture.
Make up the total volume to 25 ml with water.
Add half a tablet of protease inhibitor cocktail.
Store Buffer B at 4°C for further use.
Mix 250 µl sodium phosphate buffer (10 mM, pH7), 500 µl NaCl (100 mM), and 17.7 µl of β-mercaptoethanol.
Make up the total volume to 25 ml with water.
Add half a tablet of protease inhibitor cocktail.
Store Buffer C at 4°C for further use.
Mix 250 µl sodium phosphate buffer (10 mM, pH7), 500 µl NaCl (100 mM), and 50 µl EDTA (10 mM).
Add 125 mg sarkosyl (0.5%).
Make up the total volume to 25 ml with water.
Filter sterilize the solution.
Add half a tablet of protease inhibitor cocktail (freshly added).
Store Sonic Buffer at 4°C for further use.
Mix 2.5 ml HEPES buffer (50 mM, pH 7.5), 750 µl NaCl (150 mM), 125 µl MgCl-2 (5 mM), and 2.5 µl ZnSO-4 (10 µM).
Add 1.25 ml Triton-X-100 (1%) and 125 µl SDS (0.05%).
Filter sterilize the mixture.
Store IP Buffer at -2°C in aliquots for further use.
Mix 2 ml glycine (0.1 M), 2.5 ml NaCl (0.5 M), and 12.5 µl Tween 20 (0.05%).
Make up the total volume to 25 ml with water.
Filter sterilize the solution.
Store Elution Buffer at 4°C for further use.
Place rice seedlings (5g) from HYR:TAP tagged lines into Falcon tubes (50ml).
Rinse thoroughly with Millipore water.
Crosslink the rice tissues in crosslinking buffer containing 2% formaldehyde on ice under vacuum until air bubbles appear.
Release the vacuum after 15 minutes and mix well.
Reapply vacuum for another 25 minutes.
Add 3 ml of glycine (2.5M) to stop fixation.
Apply vacuum for another 5 minutes.
Wash cross-linked leaf samples three times with buffer A (30ml).
Dry on filter paper.
Quickly freeze the samples in liquid nitrogen.
Store samples at -80°C if needed for further use later.
Homogenize frozen tissue thoroughly in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle.
Transfer homogenized tissue to tubes containing 10 ml of buffer B.
Filter the slurry through three layers of cheese cloth and collect in a 50ml tube on ice.
Wash the filtrate with two washes of buffer A.
Centrifuge the filtrate at 3500 rpm for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Wash nuclear pellet thrice with 5 ml of buffer C.
Centrifuge again at 3500 rpm for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the pellet once with buffer D and centrifuge at 3500 rpm for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of sonic buffer.
Transfer to 2ml safelock Eppendorf tubes.
Sonicate the chromatin for 5 cycles: 30 seconds ON and 1 minute OFF for each cycle on full power.
Centrifuge the suspension at 14000 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant and centrifuge again at top speed for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant to new tubes with equal volume of IP buffer.
Keep 100 µl of the mix aside as control to check the degree of sonication.
Centrifuge the precleared chromatin at 14000 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant followed by incubation with 100 µl Protein A agarose for 1 hr 30 min.
Centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 5 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant and centrifuge again at top speed for 10 min.
Divide supernatant into three parts: one that serves as negative control (Histone Ab), the other two are samples (immunoprecipitated with 6X His and Myc antibody).
Incubate IP samples with 10 µl of antibody (1.5-2µg) for 10 h at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
Centrifuge samples at 12000 rpm for 5 min at 4°C to remove the debris and collect supernatant into 2 ml safelock tubes.
Add 50 µl Protein A agarose to the IP samples and incubate at 4°C for 2 hr on a rotating wheel.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and retain pellet (beads) for further use.
Wash the beads five times with 5 ml IP buffer at room temperature on a rotating wheel.
Elute Protein-DNA complexes by using 100 µl cold elution buffer, incubate for 5 min at 37°C.
Centrifuge at top speed for 2 min.
Collect supernatant and neutralize with 50 µl Tris-Cl (pH-9).
Repeat elution steps twice.
Add Proteinase K (11.25 µl of 20 mg/ml stock) and incubate at 37°C overnight with constant shaking on a rotating wheel.
Proceed with Input DNA sample obtained from step 13 simultaneously by adding 330 µl of TE to reach the same volume as IP sample.
Add Proteinase K (second aliquot) and incubate at 65°C overnight to allow reverse crosslinking.
Precipitate DNA by adding 1/10th volume sodium-acetate (pH 5.2), 2.5 volumes of ethanol (100%), and 1 µl of glycogen overnight at -20°C.
Centrifuge at top speed for 15 min at 4°C.
Resuspend DNA in 100 µl of Millipore water.
Purify DNA using PCR purification columns and elute in 35 µl Millipore water.
Carry out qPCR to test for enrichment of target and control primers for both positive and negative IP samples.
Calculate the fold enrichment for the His and MYC antibodies against the nonspecific antibody using the formula Ct \(Target) - Ct \(Non Specific Ab) = dCt.
Normalize against the calibrator using the equation \(2^{-ΔΔCt}\).
Prepare PBS buffer by mixing 137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 10 mM Na-2-HPO-4-, and 2 mM KH-2-PO-4-, then make up to a volume of 100 ml with dd H-2-O.
Autoclave the PBS buffer and store it at room temperature for future use.
Amplify the HYR coding region by PCR using forward and reverse primers containing attB1 and attB2 sites, respectively.
Clone PCR-purified HYR (target genes) into pDEST42 (C-6X-His tag Gateway expression vector of choice) using the Gateway cloning strategy (BP and LR reaction system).
Transform the cloned vector into E. coli strain BL-21.
Induce recombinant protein for 4 hr using 1 mM IPTG.
Pellet down cells and resuspend in PBS buffer.
Add lysozyme at a concentration of 4 mg/ml to the suspended cells and incubate for 30 min on ice.
Sonicate the mixture for 3 min (50% duty cycle) with pulses of 15 s.
Pellet down cells by centrifugation at 12,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant and use it for protein purification using Ni-NTA agarose.
Confirm identity of the proteins by immunoblotting with His-tag antibody or any antibody of choice at a dilution of 1:1000.

Design specific sets of primers for amplifying 250 bp fragments spanning binding sites in the promoter region of target genes and their downstream genes using genomic DNA of Nipponbare rice as template.
Gel purify the amplified promoter fragments.
Label the purified promoter fragments using Biotin 3' End DNA Labeling Kit.
Perform binding reactions according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate the binding reactions for 10 minutes on ice after adding 100-fold excess of unlabeled competitor DNA.
Add labeled DNA and incubate further for 20 minutes on ice before loading onto a 5% native polyacrylamide gel.
Electroblot resolved DNA-protein complexes onto Nylon membrane.
Detect gel-shift using the chemiluminescent nucleic acid detection kit.
Prepare Buffer A by mixing 0.6M mannitol, 10 mM MES at pH 5.7, and 10 mM CaCl2.
Autoclave and store Buffer A at room temperature.
Dehull rice seeds (Nipponbare).
Sterilize the dehulled seeds in 75% ethanol for 30 seconds.
Sterilize the seeds in 75% bleach with continuous shaking for 30 minutes.
Wash sterilized seeds three times with sterile water.
Wash sterilized seeds once with MS liquid medium.
Incubate the seeds in a quarter MS medium (0.8% Gellan gum) at 28°C for 15 days under a photoperiod of 12 hours light (about 150 μmol m^-2^ s^-1^) and 12 hours dark.
Cut rice plants into strips of 0.5-1mm length using a sharp razor blade.
Place the cut strips immediately into 20ml buffer A for 10 min at 28°C with shaking (60-80 rpm) in the dark.
Discard buffer A and incubate the samples in 20ml of buffer B for 6 hr in the dark at 28°C with constant shaking (60-80 rpm).
Dilute the enzyme solution with an equal volume of buffer C to remove undigested protoplasts before filtration.
Filter the diluted enzyme/protoplast solution through three layers of pre-wetted cheese cloth.
Wash leaf tissues twice with buffer C and pool the filtrate.
Centrifuge the filtered solution at 2500 rpm for 5 min in a swing bucket rotor to collect the protoplasts.
Wash the collected protoplasts once with buffer C after centrifugation.
Resuspend the protoplasts in MMG solution at a concentration of 2×10^6 cells/mL using a haemocytometer.
Incubate 300 µl of freshly prepared protoplast with 15 µg of plasmid DNA in a microcentrifuge tube.
Mix gently by tapping and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Carry out electroporation using Multiporator (Eppendorf) with conditions: 5 msec, 400 V and 200 µF and 2 pulses.
Incubate the protoplast-DNA solution after electroporation in ice for 10 min.
Dilute the protoplast-DNA solution with buffer C and then pellet by centrifugation at 3500 rpm for 5 min.
Resuspend the protoplasts gently in 1 mL buffer D (0.5 M mannitol, 20 mM KCl and 4 mM MES at pH 5.7).
Incubate overnight at 28°C.
Harvest protoplasts by centrifugation at 2000 rpm for 5 min after the desired period of incubation.
Discard the supernatant.
Store the pelleted protoplasts at -80°C for further use.
Incubate 300 µl of protoplast with reporter and effector constructs (15 µg of plasmid DNA each).
Include a control tube containing only protoplast.
Incubate the pelleted protoplasts with 100 µl of protoplast lysis buffer.
Mix thoroughly by vortexing for 5 seconds.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 12,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Collect supernatant for luciferase assay.
Mix 75 µl of supernatant with an equal volume of LAR reagent (prepared according to Promega technical manual).
Measure luminescence after 10 minutes in Glomax 20/20 luminometer.
Stop reaction by adding Dual Glo Stop and Glow solution.
Measure luminescence due to Renilla luciferase in the same order as firefly luminescence was measured.
Express results normalized to the Renilla luminescence.
Mix freshly prepared protoplast with 15 µg of plasmid (construct containing the gene of interest fused with HER).
Incubate protoplasts with 2 μM estradiol for 6 hours to induce gene activity.
Apply the same concentration of ethanol used to dissolve estradiol as a mock treatment for control protoplasts.
Treat protoplasts with cycloheximide at 2 μM 30 minutes before adding estradiol to inhibit new protein synthesis where indicated.
Resuspend pelleted protoplasts in buffer D and incubate for 6 hours.
Harvest the cells after incubation and store them at -80°C for further analysis.
Isolate total RNA using the Trizol method from Invitrogen technical manual.
Synthesize cDNA using 1 µg of total RNA (DNase treated) and analyze expression of downstream target genes by qRT-PCR.
Express fold change of target genes as a mean of three replicates.
Test the statistical significance of variation over wild-type and transgenic controls using a 2-sided t-test at p≤0.01.
